description: GHOST CTRL: sets the accent amounts and the master level for every Ghost voice it touches, so the separate voices behave as one instrument

params.text: Sets how much an Accent A gate lifts a hit, across the whole kit
Sets how much an Accent B gate lifts a hit, across the whole kit
Scales the output of every voice on the chain
Sets how far an unaccented hit drops below an accented one, marked Tight, Classic and Wide

inputs.text: Adds to the Accent A knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the Accent B knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the master knob, the whole knob range over 10V

notes: this module carries no audio and no triggers: it is placed against a Ghost voice and its settings pass along the row through every Ghost module that touches the next
the per-step triggers and accent gates are patched by cable from a sequencer to each voice; they do not travel along this chain
the dynamic range switch scales a voice's accent floor, so it changes only the voices that have one, which at present is the kick alone

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
